inclusion_criteria.title: Inclusion criteria
inclusion_criteria.description: Short phrases the LLM uses to decide whether to include a paper. Anything matching these → likely include.

exclusion_criteria.title: Exclusion criteria
exclusion_criteria.description: Short phrases that should disqualify a paper. Anything matching these → likely exclude.

confidence_threshold.title: Confidence threshold
confidence_threshold.description: Records below this LLM confidence get flagged for human review. 0.7 is a reasonable default.
